summary: Skier killed in avalanche near Silverton
notes: Reported in avalanche-center 2012-13 season index; name not in opened source Unofficial Networks 2013-02-03 names the deceased as 23-year-old Durango man Peter Carver (fully buried ~5 ft); John Duncan Rothwell, 53, suffered a possible broken femur; Nate Klema, 23, escaped without serious injuries; Silverton Mountain ski patrol and San Juan County Sheriff's Deputy John Jacobs responded and removed the body.
